features: centre B02/B03/B04/B08, central 3x3 means, 9x9 standard deviations, log(B02/B03)
scope: One observation per 30 m HLS pixel; spatial calibration and testing use distinct buffered alongshore zones. Scores are site-specific and do not establish cross-site transfer or absolute-depth agreement between different port datums.
vertical_reference: Hydrographic zero of the Port of Agadir (confirmed by the survey-data owner)
measurement_note: Errors are against the site's aggregated survey z values. The site-local vertical reference is separate from the other study site's port datum.
